title: standardize-reauth-slices-adaptive-retry-dsl-and-checkpointed-pullstreams
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Context: We have three slightly divergent reauth and retry behaviors across the Python/TS/Go SDKs that cause intermittent session handoff bugs during long-lived pull/stream sessions. This PR introduces a small, explicit contract called 'reauth slices' (time-windowed credential refresh hints) plus an adaptive retry DSL that sits on top of existing retry primitives. It also adds a checkpointed pullstream abstraction (lightweight, opt-in) that gives consumers explicit resume points for streaming reconnects.

Motivation: Aim for behavioral parity across SDKs while keeping each SDK ergonomic for its language: minimal surface changes, explicit opt-in checkpointing for apps that need deterministic resume semantics, and clearer telemetry for auth failures to help SRE triage.

What this PR does: 
- Adds a reauth slice metadata header to outgoing streaming init requests and exposes a small ReauthSlice struct/class in each SDK binding.
- Implements an adaptive retry DSL: rules can express backoff floors, ceilings, jitter profiles, and a predicate for credential-refresh-triggered retries.
- Introduces checkpointed-pullstream helper APIs (pullstream.checkpoint() / PullStream.checkpoint() / PullStreamCheckpoint) in TS/Python/Go that serialize a resume token and last-ack offset.
- Upholds backward compatibility: existing streaming APIs continue to work; checkpointing is opt-in.
- Adds credential and auth telemetry tags emitted to the client-side metrics layer for troubleshooting (reauth_attempt, reauth_slice, refresh_latency_ms, retry_reason).
- Documents runtime safeguards: max reauth window, stale-slice rejection, retry budget accounting.

Checklist:
- [x] API surface defined for TS/Python/Go (minimal, idiomatic)
- [x] Unit tests for DSL evaluation and edge cases
- [x] Integration tests for stream reconnect+checkpoint resume
- [x] Telemetry emitted and validated in local metrics harness
- [x] Docs snippets and examples added to SDK guides
- [x] Version bumps for all three SDKs coordinated in monorepo release script

Testing & CI: Ran the TS and Py integration suites against the staging bridge that simulates intermittent token expiry; Go unit+integration ran in CI. Early CI run failed on a flaky TS e2e that exercised a timeout edge; root cause was a healthy timeout constant in tests that needed bumping — fixed and rerun. Final CI: linux-unit-tests ⬤ pass, ts-sdk-integration ⬤ pass (rerun once), py-sdk-integration ⬤ pass, go-sdk-integration ⬤ pass, lint ⬤ pass.

Rollout plan: Feature gated via SDK minor flags and server-side acceptance of reauth_slice header. Gradual ramp for production consumers: start with internal teams, then opt-in customers, then on-by-default in three weeks after metrics validate reduced auth-fallover errors.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps retry semantics composable (the adaptive DSL composes onto the existing retry middleware) to avoid hard-breaking changes in customers' custom retry policies.

review_comments: Diego Ruiz (2026-03-01): Nice surface. Two asks: (1) add a deterministic checksum to checkpoint payload so accidental corruption is detectable, (2) please ensure the Go serializer remains stable across minor releases.

Maya Thompson (2026-03-01): Added CRC32 checksum to checkpoint payload and tests that validate incompatible payloads fail to resume. Go serializer uses versioned envelope to keep stability; documented in reauth-slices.md.

Lina Park (2026-03-02): Can we add a short note on how the server should respond to reauth_slice headers when slices are stale? Suggested 400 vs 412 behavior and a telemetry tag to help identify slice mismatches.
Maya Thompson (2026-03-02): Implemented server-guidance doc and added telemetry tag stale_slice=true for server-responses; included acceptance test in py integration harness.
Connor Hayes (2026-03-03): Tests look good. One nit: the retry DSL default presets might be aggressive for high-throughput customers; recommend a conservative 'economy' preset.
Maya Thompson (2026-03-03): Added 'economy' preset and updated docs to recommend it for resource-constrained deployments.

release_notes: Add reauth-slice metadata to streaming init, adaptive retry DSL with new presets, and opt-in checkpointed pullstream helper for deterministic resume. Minor SDK bumps: py->1.13.0, ts->2.8.0, go->0.10.0.
notes_for_changelog: Behavioural parity for reauth and retry across SDKs; opt-in checkpointing for streaming resumes; telemetry tags for auth troubleshooting.
backout_plan: If rollout exposes regressions: 1) flip SDK gate to disable reauth_slice header emission, 2) revert server-side acceptance of reauth_slice in staging, 3) revert monorepo release bump.
post_merge_actions: Monitor auth-fallover SLO dashboard, validate telemetry for reauth_attempts and stale_slice tags for two weeks; ship SDK docs patch and announce opt-in to customers.
